   **Pricing and paywall.**

      Review window: Sep 29, 2026 - Oct 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Michael S_, Oct 2, 2026, 1/5: "Don't waste your time on this app. I've paid for a year and they're unable to give me the rewards I've paid for. Very predatory, I'll have to deal with the bank to flag it. it's a zero star review. It takes them weeks to answer back for any inquiries or issues you may have."
            2. _Dimantha Amarasinghe_, Sep 29, 2026, 1/5: "setup takes 20 minutes, clunky ui, very greedy subscription prices. doesn't work without internet connection. hevy app is infinitely better for quarter of the price. this app is just influencer slop cashgrab."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 18, 2026 - Sep 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Nopal Ibrahim_, Sep 30, 2026, 1/5: "i have issues with signing up an account, when i want to check out my 7 day trial the payment froze and i cant continue, so basically im stuck on the sign up page, it is nice for the devs and teams to offer a free trial but make sure the client also has the option to pass the trial and continue signing their account, please fix this as soon as possible, i want to try the app"
            2. _Paul Lapouge Dalbavie_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "Much too expensive application which offers you a first month for 6€ but the next one what was my surprise to realize that the monthly subscription was then more than 70€, of course if I had not looked in detail on the Play Store it is impossible to know Despite it being a good application despite the recurring bugs, it is much too expensive for what it is"
            3. _Liam Els_, Sep 28, 2026, 2/5: "great concept, and interface, but very buggy still. name brand food don't show in list, searching foods like egg, I have to scroll down 20 items to find a plain egg instead of options like congee egg and omelet, after using it at some point the search box just glitch out too, moving my cursur after every letter. And when creating a workout, the numbers don't fit in the test boxes, they get cut off."
